title: Boom Chip
description: A food item called the Boom Chip that explodes killing you and anyone in your vicinity
body:
A mod that adds a brand new food item called the Boom Chip crafted with a potato and gunpowder that explodes when eaten damaging you and anyone nearby.

This is really only being made to joke around with your mates and cause some funny moments.

Hope you have fun with it!

This mod was created as a simple inside joke so there isnt too much to write here.

If you have any feedback I'd love to hear it!
Leave it to me in the comments or the discord below.
